badge.openHint: People who have access can contribute.
badge.membersOnlyHint: Only the people allowed by the creator can contribute.

description.wordGroup: Allowed people can add words to it, and edit or delete their own (or every word, with a full sharing). When closed, only you can change the list; the words already added are kept. When private and closed, the group is only visible to you: its members get their access back if it is reopened.
description.groupCollection: Allowed people can add groups to it, and remove the ones they added (or every group, with a full sharing). When closed, only you can change its groups; the ones already added are kept. When private and closed, the collection is only visible to you: its members get their access back if it is reopened.

everyone.wordGroup: Everyone who can see the group
everyone.groupCollection: Everyone who can see the collection

membersOnly.label: Only the people I allow
membersOnly.description: Everyone can view it, but only the people you accept through the share link can contribute.

inviteHint.edition: Once saved, invite these people with the link of the “Sharing” section, just below.

creation.wordGroup: Once the group is created, invite these people with the link of the “Sharing” section.
creation.groupCollection: Once the collection is created, invite these people with the link of the “Sharing” section.
